Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising predominantly in the digestive tract; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.

Defined by ear malformations and hearing impairment with branchial anomalies; renal disease is not established for this branchiootic concept.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with spasticity, abnormal movements and CNS myelination defects; isolated amyotrophy does not establish common primary muscle damage.
Renal cystic dysplasia with kidney failure in 4/7; hypertension in 5/7 is secondary without demonstrated direct vascular injury. Hepatosplenomegaly occurs in only 1/7.
